name: Asthra
description: Asthra is an Execution Operating System that connects opportunity discovery, knowledge, planning, delivery, operations, health, automation, governance, and analytics.
rules: Core owns identity, membership, scope, roles, and permissions.
No service owns users except Core.
targetUser: Engineering and product teams at growing companies, 20–200 people, who need structured execution without enterprise tool overhead.
doNotTouch: shared packages (shared-auth, shared-db, shared-events, shared-schemas, shared-platform) without explicit instruction
alembic migration files without explicit instruction
migrationRule: All new Alembic migrations creating tables or indexes MUST wrap op.create_table with 'if not table_exists(...)' and op.create_index with 'if not index_exists(...)' using helpers from app.db.migration_utils. No exceptions. alembic/versions/ is baked into the Docker image — run 'docker compose build core-service' after changes.

beforeStarting: Read relevant service AI_CONTEXT.md if touching backend
beforeFinishing: Append to .asthra/memory/decisions.md if any architectural choice was made
Update .asthra/memory/bugs.md for any bug fixed or discovered
Run npm run generate:api before build if OpenAPI types may have changed (requires core-service at localhost:8000)
Run npm run build if frontend was touched
Report summary of files changed and tests run
